Type: acceptance gate
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: C01
Accountable role (person unassigned): Ingestion engineer and source curator
Pilot scope: conditional; requires explicit SITE01.3 activation

Outcome: Only the advertised source installation and acquisition profiles are claimed as qualified.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Survey the named XNAT installation/resources and/or DICOM collection, preserve restricted evidence, specify mappings and independent scientific fixtures, and record exclusions.
2. Rehearse interruption, source/output accounting and final reconciliation with the real permitted collection; conversion success alone is insufficient.
3. When SITE01 selects this source for beta, make this item a blocking program dependency; otherwise keep it distinct from native-BIDS beta and retain original migration-pilot obligations.

Review all child evidence against these integration criteria. Children closing does not automatically close this gate. Required human/institutional evidence must be observed, never inferred from automated tests.

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; create blocking remediation work for discovered scope. Automated or simulated evidence cannot replace a required institutional or human result. No implementation is claimed by this plan.
Deferred scope is not completion. Do not start conditional implementation merely because it appears in mote ready.
